spec.title: Top $top_limit by longest TX time
spec.description: Includes "idle in transaction" TX.  5 / 10 min default thresholds

spec.rawSql:
SELECT * FROM (
SELECT
  dbname,
  max((data->>'longest_tx_seconds')::int) AS longest_tx_seconds
FROM
  backends
WHERE
  $__timeFilter("time")
GROUP BY
  dbname
) x
WHERE longest_tx_seconds > 0
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT $top_limit

select * from (
select 
  dbname,
  max((data->>'percent')::float) as used_percent
from
  psutil_disk
where
  $__timeFilter("time")
  and (data->>'percent')::float > 0
group by
  dbname
) x
order by 2 desc nulls last
limit $top_limit

spec.title: Top $top_limit by used connections
spec.description: Assumes get_stat_activity() helper for non-privileged monitoring users

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
 dbname,
 round(100 * instance_total::numeric / max_connections, 1) AS "pct_used",
 instance_total AS used_connections,
 max_connections
FROM
  (
    select
      distinct on (dbname)
      dbname,
      (data->>'max_connections')::int as max_connections,
      (data->>'instance_total')::int as instance_total
    FROM
      backends
    WHERE
      $__timeFilter(time)
    order by dbname, time desc
  ) x
ORDER BY
  2 DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT
  $top_limit

spec.title: Top $top_limit by CPU utilization %
spec.description: Assumes "psutil_cpu" helpers are installed and configured

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
 dbname,
 round(max((data->>'cpu_utilization')::numeric), 1) AS "cpu_utilization"
FROM
  psutil_cpu
WHERE
  $__timeFilter("time")
GROUP BY
  1
ORDER BY
  2 DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT
  $top_limit

spec.title: Top $top_limit by WAL folder size
spec.description: Needs "get_wal_size" helper for unprivileged monitoring users

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
 dbname,
 max((data->>'wal_size_b')::int8) as wal_size
FROM
  wal_size
WHERE
  $__timeFilter("time")
GROUP BY
  1
ORDER BY
  2 DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT
  $top_limit

spec.title: Top $top_limit by JIT %
spec.description: Top $top_limit sources by the percentage of total query execution time spent in JIT. (requires stat_statements metric).

spec.rawSql:
select 
    dbname, pct
from (
    select 
        dbname,
        (sum(CASE WHEN total_jit >= total_jit_lag THEN total_jit - total_jit_lag ELSE total_jit END) / nullif(sum(CASE WHEN total_time >= total_time_lag THEN total_time - total_time_lag ELSE total_time END), 0)) * 100 as pct
    from
    (
        select
            dbname,
            (data->>'jit_generation_time')::float8 as total_jit, lag((data->>'jit_generation_time')::float8) over w as total_jit_lag,
            (data->>'total_time')::float8 as total_time, lag((data->>'total_time')::float8) over w as total_time_lag
        from stat_statements
        where $__timeFilter(time)
        window w as (order by time)
    )
    group by 1
)
where pct > 0
order by 2 desc
limit $top_limit

spec.title: Monitored primary DB-s
spec.description:
Please adjust the markers as needed!

Also the default query assumes that all DBs are separate instances. If not so change the query to add some filters or groupings based on the wal.sys_id column for example.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  0 AS "time",
  count(distinct dbname)
FROM wal
WHERE
  $__timeFilter("time")
  AND (data->>'in_recovery_int')::int = 0

spec.title: Monitored replica DB-s
spec.description:
Please adjust the markers as needed!

Also the default query assumes that all DBs are separate instances. If not so change the query to add some filters or groupings based on the wal.sys_id column for example.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  0 AS "time",
  count(distinct dbname)
FROM
  wal
WHERE
  $__timeFilter("time")
  AND (data->>'in_recovery_int')::int = 1

spec.title: Offline nodes
spec.description: Configured to be monitored but no recent data

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
 dbname,
 (SELECT CASE WHEN data->>'in_recovery_int' = '0' THEN 'primary' ELSE 'replica' END FROM wal WHERE dbname = c.dbname ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_role,
 (SELECT (extract(epoch from now() - time))::int8 FROM instance_up WHERE (data->>'instance_up')::int8 = 1 AND dbname = c.dbname ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_seen,
 (SELECT (data->>'postmaster_uptime_s')::int FROM db_stats WHERE dbname = c.dbname ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1) AS last_seen_uptime
FROM
  (SELECT DISTINCT ON (dbname) * FROM instance_up ORDER BY dbname, time DESC) AS c
WHERE
  (data->>'instance_up')::int8 = 0
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
ORDER BY dbname, time DESC

spec.title: Top $top_limit by blocked sessions
spec.description: Assumes get_stat_activity() helper for non-privileged monitoring users

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
 dbname,
 max((data->>'waiting')::int) AS "waiting"
FROM
  backends
WHERE
  $__timeFilter("time")
  AND (data->>'waiting')::int > 0
GROUP BY
  1
ORDER BY
  2 DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT
  $top_limit

select * from (
select
  dbname,
  avg((CASE WHEN roll >= roll_lag THEN roll-roll_lag ELSE roll END)::numeric / nullif((CASE WHEN roll >= roll_lag THEN roll-roll_lag ELSE roll END) + (CASE WHEN comm >= comm_lag THEN comm-comm_lag ELSE comm END), 0))*100 as "rollback_ratio"
from (
  select
      dbname,
      time,
      (data->>'xact_rollback')::int8 as roll, lag((data->>'xact_rollback')::int8) over w as roll_lag,
      (data->>'xact_commit')::int8 as comm, lag((data->>'xact_commit')::int8) over w as comm_lag
  FROM
      db_stats
  WHERE
    $__timeFilter("time")
    window w as (partition by dbname order by time)
) x
GROUP BY 1
) y
WHERE rollback_ratio > 0
ORDER BY 2 DESC
LIMIT $top_limit

select * from (
select 
  dbname,
  max((data->>'replay_lag_b')::int8) as replay_lag_b
from
  replication
where
  (data->>'replay_lag_b')::int8 > 0
group by
  dbname
) x
order by 2 desc
limit $top_limit

select * from (
select
  dbname,
  avg((CASE WHEN tb >= tb_lag THEN tb-tb_lag ELSE tb END) / (etime - lag_etime))*60 as "temp_bytes_per_minute"
from (
        select
          dbname,
          (data->>'temp_bytes')::int8 as tb, lag((data->>'temp_bytes')::int8) over w as tb_lag,
          (extract(epoch from time))::int8 as etime,
          (lag(extract(epoch from time)) over w)::int8 as lag_etime
        from db_stats
        where $__timeFilter(time)
        window w as (partition by dbname order by time)
) x
where
  etime > lag_etime
group by
  dbname
) y
where temp_bytes_per_minute > 0
order by 2 desc
limit $top_limit
